name: wallet_transfer_phone_lookup
definition:
CREATE INDEX wallet_transfer_phone_lookup ON public.profiles USING btree (campus_id, (
CASE
    WHEN (regexp_replace(phone, '[+() .-]'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text) ~ '^2340[0-9]{10}$'::text) THEN ('234'::text || "right"(regexp_replace(phone, '[+() .-]'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text), 10))
    WHEN (regexp_replace(phone, '[+() .-]'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text) ~ '^0[0-9]{10}$'::text) THEN ('234'::text || "right"(regexp_replace(phone, '[+() .-]'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text), 10))
    WHEN (regexp_replace(phone, '[+() .-]'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text) ~ '^[0-9]{10}$'::text) THEN ('234'::text || regexp_replace(phone, '[+() .-]'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text))
    ELSE regexp_replace(phone, '[+() .-]'::text, ''::text, 'g'::text)
END)) WHERE is_active
